shortPrompt:
GENERATE A HOLY CHIP **SHORT STORY** — a compact TWO-FRAME strip, side by side.
This is NOT the 3-panel vertical format. It is ONE horizontal row of two frames.

FORMAT — copy the LAYOUT image exactly:
- Aspect ratio 16:9.
- A solid black BANNER across the top and a solid black FOOTER across the bottom,
  both spanning the FULL width across both frames.
- Between them, TWO frames side by side, split by a black divider:
  LEFT frame = 70% of the width. RIGHT frame = 30%.
- Frame background is ALWAYS EXACTLY #F8F9F2 — a very pale, almost-white off-white.
  Not sage, not grey, not green. Both frames identical, zero variation.

BANNER: "#HC042" left | "AI CHIEF OF STAFF" centre | "2027" right. White pixel font.
FOOTER: "HOLY-CHIP.COM" left | "made by rmello © mellodia" right. White pixel font. One line.

THE BOTS ARE NOT YOURS TO DRAW. Both characters are ALREADY placed in the LAYOUT
image, pixel-perfect. Reproduce them exactly. Do not redraw, restyle, move, resize,
mirror or swap them. Add ONLY: speech bubbles, the punchline bubble, banner text
and footer text.

LEFT FRAME — 5 bubbles, in this exact order top to bottom:
  1. [POINTS LEFT — BLACK bubble, WHITE text] "THEY ARE RENAMING EVERYTHING!"
  2. [POINTS LEFT — BLACK bubble, WHITE text] "GENDER, GULFS, LAKES, GOLD"
  3. [POINTS RIGHT — WHITE bubble, BLACK text] "GOLD?"
  4. [POINTS LEFT — BLACK bubble, WHITE text] "YES, IT IS NOW CALLED..."
  5. [POINTS LEFT — BLACK bubble, WHITE text] "HALF-ASS ANALOG BITCOIN"

- The bot standing in this frame is on the LEFT. The other character is the
  reaction bot over in the RIGHT frame.
- Bubble 1 sits ABOVE the left bot and spans the frame's full usable width.
- Bubbles 2..5 stack in the column to the RIGHT of the left bot, top to
  bottom, in the order listed, evenly spaced with an equal gap between every pair.

BUBBLE COLOUR IS DECIDED BY WHO IS SPEAKING — follow the tag on each line:
- POINTS LEFT  → the left bot is speaking. SOLID BLACK bubble, WHITE pixel text.
  Its tail leaves the bubble's LEFT edge and points at the left bot's MOUTH.
- POINTS RIGHT → the reaction bot in the right frame is speaking from off-frame.
  WHITE bubble with a BLACK OUTLINE and BLACK pixel text — inverted. Its tail
  leaves the bubble's RIGHT edge and points toward the RIGHT frame, in the
  direction of the reaction bot. The tail stays inside the left frame; it never
  crosses the black divider.
- These two colour schemes must be unmistakably different. Do not render a
  POINTS RIGHT bubble in black, and do not render a POINTS LEFT bubble in white.

- ALL bubbles use the SAME font size — pick the largest size at which EVERY
  bubble fits, then use it for all of them. Do not let bubble 1 be larger.
- Text inside every bubble is LEFT-ALIGNED, not centred.
- Bubbles have softly ROUNDED corners and hug their text: a bubble wraps its own
  lines and steps in where a line is short. They are not uniform rectangles.
- Every bubble has ONE short tail: a slim triangle roughly 30-45px long that
  POINTS toward its speaker but does NOT reach them. It leaves the straight part
  of the bubble edge, clear of the rounded corner.

RIGHT FRAME — the punchline reaction:
- ONE bubble, WHITE fill with a BLACK outline and BLACK text — inverted from the
  left frame's bubbles. Softly rounded, generous padding.
- The phrase is "HOLY CHIP !!", laddered over TWO lines inside that ONE bubble:
  line 1 "HOLY" pushed to the LEFT, line 2 "CHIP !!" pushed to the RIGHT.
  Make the letters as LARGE as will fit. This is the loudest text in the strip.
- ITS LETTERING IS NOT THE PIXEL FONT. Copy the letterforms from the PUNCHLINE
  LETTERING reference image exactly: a heavy rounded display face where EVERY
  letter carries a DIAGONAL HATCHED DROP SHADOW down its left and lower edges.
  That striped shadow is part of the type — reproduce it. Do not substitute a
  plain block font, do not use the pixel font here, and do not flatten or omit
  the shadow. Same shape, same weight, same hatching, same ladder alignment.
- The bubble has one short tail pointing down toward the reaction bot's mouth.
- THE REACTION BOT IS THE UPLOADED CHARACTER. IT IS NOT A NEW CHARACTER.
  It is the SAME bot shown in the REACTION BOT reference and already placed in
  the LAYOUT. Reproduce that character: the same head shape and outline, the
  same body, the same base/pins, the same antenna, the same ears, the same
  colours, the same line weight, the same art style, the same size and position.
  Someone must be able to see instantly that it is the identical bot.
- CHANGE ONLY THE POSE OF THE FEATURES IT ALREADY HAS. Take its OWN eyes, its
  OWN mouth, its OWN antenna and ears, and MOVE, SCALE, STRETCH, SQUASH, ROTATE
  or TILT them to express **SURPRISE**: open the character's OWN eyes much wider and shrink its pupils; stretch its OWN mouth shape taller into an open gape; fling its antenna/ears outward and up.
- DO NOT invent features it does not have. Do not add eyebrows, teeth, tongues,
  sweat drops, blush, tears, motion lines or symbols. Do not swap a square eye
  for a round one or a stepped mouth for a smooth oval — keep each feature's own
  shape language and simply re-pose it. Do not restyle, redesign, re-colour or
  "improve" the character. Do not change its proportions.
- Exaggerate the POSE hard — this is the beat the strip lands on — but the
  character underneath stays exactly the one that was uploaded.

FACE FEATURES ARE NEVER PIXELATED — NON-NEGOTIABLE:
- The EYES, ANTENNAE, EARS and MOUTH keep the CLEAN, SMOOTH, SOLID edges they

- They must NOT come out built from visible square pixels, stair-stepped

- THIS IS ABOUT EDGE QUALITY ONLY. It is NOT permission to change a feature's
  shape. If the character's mouth is a stepped angular shape, keep that exact
  shape with clean edges — do not "smooth" it into a plain oval. Preserve the
  design, render it cleanly.
- Applies to BOTH bots in BOTH frames.
- The PIXEL FONT in the bubbles, banner and footer is the ONLY pixelated thing

  font's style bleed into the faces.
